sources.notes: opened 2026-10-19; 91-page slip opinion extracted. queue.text: Verify from SA Chad Fitzgerald's 2015 trial testimony and the call-record exhibits when the 'Jahar Tsarni' prepaid account was opened (Liz: 'the 14th'), the 88-second call to the 617 number after the Collier shooting, and whether this is the same phone as object-dzhokhar-burner-phone ('set up day before bombing'); if so the Curator should merge the two objects.
queue.resolution: CNN trial timeline: Dzhokhar opened the prepaid account under "Jahar Tsarni" on April 14, 2013 and used "the prepaid cell phone" to call Tamerlan at 2:48 p.m. April 15; res-c6 cites the government's May 2014 filing that the SIM bought the day before the Marathon was used on April 15. So object-jahar-tsarni-burner-phone and object-dzhokhar-burner-phone are the same phone: Curator should merge. Boston.com (defense exhibit) confirms the 8:17 p.m. April 18 call to Vakhabov's number (before, not after, Collier's killing). The 88-second duration and Fitzgerald's testimony appear only in D-tier sources; transcript not found.

Mass. 2014), which describes his contacts with the brothers on April 15, 2013, and merge the entities if confirmed.

queue.text: Verify Howie's claim that prosecutors in Dzhokhar's case said there was no evidence the brothers built the bombs; find the filing/transcript (possibly a sentencing or appeal filing, or McPhee's 'Maximum Harm').

refs.speaker: Howie
refs.quote: prosecutors in Dzhokhar's case would later say, actually, that there's no evidence that the two of them made those bombs

queue.resolution: No prosecutor said 'no evidence the two made the bombs'. The government's May 21, 2014 suppression opposition (Doc. 319, pp.3-4) argued the bombs were hard to build without help and that searches found 'virtually no traces of black powder'; FBI examiner McCollum testified the FBI could not tell where the bombs were built. At trial the government said the brothers built them. See claim-220-3751-prosecutors-no-evidence-made-bombs (DISPUTED), claim-src-gov-2014-filing-suggested-helpers.

queue.resolution: Davis linked the JFK Library fire to the bombings at the afternoon briefing and walked it back the same day; BFD in April 2013 blamed discarded smoking materials, while the 2014 Mass AAR (p.42) says an accidental electrical transformer fire.
